data.title: 爱丽丝 · 哨站地下胡萝卜小窝的童话时间
data.action: 双手抓着毛茸茸的兔耳兜帽边沿，跪坐在粉红地毯上摇晃身体，怀里抱着巨大的机械胡萝卜抱枕，纯真无邪的蓝粉大眼睛忽闪忽闪
data.location: 哨站指挥官宿舍地下的爱丽丝秘密游乐房
data.lighting: 墙面荧光星星贴纸散发的梦幻微光，与草莓小夜灯的粉暖柔光包围全身
data.mood: 纯真甜美、童趣梦幻、全身心的依恋与信赖
data.description: 熄灯后的哨站地下小室。爱丽丝脱下紧绷的恒温战斗服，穿上了指挥官为她定制的仙境兔兔粉白绒球连帽保暖睡衣。她像小兔子一样跪坐在软地毯上，双手拉着毛茸茸的兔耳朵兜帽左右晃悠，怀里死死搂着大胡萝卜玩偶。看见你走进来，她眼睛瞬间亮起——「贵宾！今天的睡前童话书准备好了吗？爱丽丝已经乖乖钻进温暖的小窝里等你了哦！」
data.promptProse: Alice kneels happily on a soft pink carpet inside her secret playroom before sleep, wearing a pastel-pink and marshmallow-white thermal fleece loungewear set with an oversized bunny-eared hood, pom-pom ties, and soft sleep shorts. Squeezing a giant plush carrot in her arms while smiling warmly toward the viewer, she glows under a strawberry nightlamp and luminous star decals.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling on a soft pink carpet in a pastel bunny-eared fleece hoodie and plush sleep shorts, she hugs a giant carrot plushie and holds her hood edges with a bright, innocent smile. Warm pink strawberry nightlamp light mingles with glowing wall stars.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pastel-pink and marshmallow-white fleece loungewear set with an oversized bunny-eared hood, pom-pom drawstrings, and plush sleep shorts.
